answer: Each agent stakes a unique marble token bound to a hardware beacon that emits a verifiable plume of signed timing pulses. Forging a sybil identity requires acquiring a fresh marble and spoofing its beacon, which costs more than the rewards a fake account could earn prior to peers detect the mismatched plume. Honest agents thus outcompete attackers, since every duplicate identity carries real hardware and stake expense. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
